queries.name: grand_totals_full_scope_and_comparable
queries.purpose: Show the headline totals for like-for-like branches and isolate current revenue from the new branch.
queries.intent: Return one row with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021, applying branch filters to all four branch-bearing tables: MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. Also return in the same one-row result a separate current-only figure for new-branch revenue filtered to MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no] = CFH022 and the same branch filter on the other branch-bearing tables where applicable so the report can show new-branch revenue separately from like-for-like performance.

queries.name: monthly_trend_comparable
queries.purpose: Show the recent month-by-month movement for the like-for-like branches so the summary can lead with the most recent period.
queries.intent: Summarize by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[month] and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[max_date] for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021, with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply branch filters to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. Return the latest 15 rows sorted by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[max_date] DESC.

queries.name: branch_performance_comparable
queries.purpose: Show which like-for-like branches are driving the group result.
queries.intent: Summarize by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no] for CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021 only, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply the like-for-like branch filter to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. Return up to 15 rows sorted by [revenue Growth] DESC.

queries.name: division_breakdown_comparable
queries.purpose: Show the main higher-level categories behind current like-for-like performance.
queries.intent: Summarize by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[division_name] for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply branch filters to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. Return the top 15 rows sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending.

queries.name: product_group_movers_comparable
queries.purpose: Identify the product groups with the largest positive and negative like-for-like revenue changes.
queries.intent: Summarize by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[product_group_name] for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply branch filters to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. queries.name: branch_by_special_product_group_cross
queries.purpose: Show the biggest branch-by-category combinations behind the like-for-like movement.
queries.intent: Summarize by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no] crossed with MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[special_product_group_name] for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021, returning [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply branch filters to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. Return the top 15 combinations sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending.

queries.name: category_risk_summary_comparable
queries.purpose: Quantify how many categories are declining and what share of revenue they represent for the like-for-like branches.
queries.intent: Return one row for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021 with CAT_TABLE measures [COUNT], [COUNT_TOTAL], [COUNT %], [sum deg cur rev], [sum deg past rev], [sum total cur rev], [sum total past rev], [contribution cur], and [contribution past]. Apply the branch filter to CAT_TABLE[store_no] and also to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no] so all branch-bearing tables stay aligned. No grouping, one row.

queries.name: daily_transactions_recent_true_branch_counts
queries.purpose: Add a current-year recent transactions view using the daily branch transaction table, without using it for year-on-year comparison.
queries.intent: Summarize rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt by rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[TY_DATE] and rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[LOC_CODE] for LOC_CODE values CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 only, computing true branch transactions from rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[LOC_BILLS] by taking the value once per date and branch level rather than summing repeated rows under departments or sections. Exclude dates after the latest date that has values in rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[LOC_BILLS]. Return the latest 15 date-branch rows sorted by rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[TY_DATE] DESC.
